en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Rifa’at, from Aban Bin Taghlub,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who is dying and there is no inheritor for him, nor a master. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He would be from the rightful ones of this Verse
[Shakir 8:1] They are asking you about the spoils of war’.
